agent.problem: The card cites only Jonah 2:7, but its second sentence also retells Jonah 2:4 when it says Jonah had said he would look toward God's temple once more. The citation is narrower than the verses the card uses; following the first-to-last rule, it would be Jonah 2:4-7.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

agent.problem: Neither card 16 nor the earlier setup establishes that Jonah will sacrifice or that he has made a vow. The baker must guess the unseen wording of Jonah 2:9, especially since both "sacrifice" and "bow" fit the first blank and "vowed," "planned," and "dreamed" can all fit the second.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
